name: SelfContainedService
summary: Designs a service so that it answers a synchronous request without waiting on any other service, keeping a replica of what it needs to read and finishing the rest asynchronously.

roles.name: SelfContainedService
roles.summary: The service that makes no synchronous call while handling a request, so that its availability is its own rather than the product of everything it would have called. What it pays is a reply that cannot say whether the work succeeded, and a caller that has to come back and ask.
